name: Strasserwirt
beschreibung: The Strasserwirt is a traditional inn in St. Johann in Tirol, nestled in the mountain landscape of the Kaiserwald. The furnishings combine Tyrolean coziness with modern comfort – wood-paneled parlors, traditional home-style cuisine with regional specialties, and comfortable rooms with alpine flair. Guests appreciate the house as a starting point for hikes and ski tours in the Kaiser-Gebirge as well as a place to relax after a day in nature. The inn offers a warm, informal atmosphere for those seeking relaxation.
